passages.text: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the angel of the church in Sardis.
Jesus holds the seven Spirits of God.
Jesus holds the seven stars.
Jesus says these words.
Jesus knows the deeds of the church in Sardis.
The church in Sardis has a reputation for being alive.
The church in Sardis is actually dead.
passages.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Σάρδεσιν ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἔχων τὰ ἑπτὰ Πνεύματα τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα ὅτι ὄνομα ἔχεις ὅτι ζῇς καὶ νεκρὸς εἶ

passages.text: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which was about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Sardis.
Jesus holds the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars.
Jesus says, “Wake up.”
Strengthen what remains.
What remains is about to die.
I have looked at your deeds.
Your deeds are not complete before My God.
passages.original: γίνου γρηγορῶν καὶ στήρισον τὰ λοιπὰ ἃ ἔμελλον ἀποθανεῖν οὐ γὰρ εὕρηκά σου τὰ ἔργα πεπληρωμένα ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ μου

passages.text: Remember, then, what you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour when I will come upon you.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Sardis.
Jesus holds the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars.
Jesus says, Remember what you have received.
Remember what you have heard.
Obey what you have received and heard.
Repent from your wrong ways.
If you do not wake up, I will come to you like a thief.
You will not know the hour when I come to you.
passages.original: μνημόνευε οὖν πῶς εἴληφας καὶ ἤκουσας καὶ τήρει καὶ μετανόησον ἐὰν οὖν μὴ γρηγορήσῃς ἥξω ὡς κλέπτης καὶ οὐ μὴ γνῷς ποίαν ὥραν ἥξω ἐπὶ σέ

passages.text: But you do have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white.
passages.sermon:
In Sardis, you have a few people.
These people have not soiled their garments.
They are worthy.
They will walk with Me in white.
passages.original: Ἀλλὰ ἔχεις ὀλίγα ὀνόματα ἐν Σάρδεσιν ἃ οὐκ ἐμόλυναν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν καὶ περιπατήσουσιν μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐν λευκοῖς ὅτι ἄξιοί εἰσιν

passages.text: Like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and His angels.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Sardis.
He promises a reward to those who overcome.
The one who overcomes will wear white clothes.
I will never erase his name from the Book of Life.
I will speak his name before My Father.
I will speak his name before the angels.
passages.original: Ὁ νικῶν οὕτως περιβαλεῖται ἐν ἱματίοις λευκοῖς καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξαλείψω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς βίβλου τῆς ζωῆς καὶ ὁμολογήσω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Πατρός μου καὶ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ

passages.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
passages.sermon: The Spirit speaks to the churches.\r\nAnyone who has an ear should listen.\r\nEach person must hear what the Spirit says.
passages.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις

passages.text: To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is holy and true.
Jesus holds the key of David.
Jesus speaks to the angel of the church in Philadelphia.
Jesus opens doors that no one can shut.
Jesus shuts doors that no one can open.
passages.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Φιλαδελφείᾳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἅγιος ὁ ἀληθινός ὁ ἔχων τὴν κλεῖν Δαυίδ ὁ ἀνοίγων καὶ οὐδεὶς κλείσει καὶ κλείων καὶ οὐδεὶς ἀνοίγει

passages.text: I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. For you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Philadelphia.
Jesus is holy and true.
Jesus holds the key of David.
Jesus says, "I know your deeds."
I have put an open door in front of you.
No one can shut this door.
You have only a little strength.
You have kept My word.
You have not denied My name.
passages.original: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα ἰδοὺ δέδωκα ἐνώπιόν σου θύραν ἠνεῳγμένην ἣν οὐδεὶς δύναται κλεῖσαι αὐτήν ὅτι μικρὰν ἔχεις δύναμιν καὶ ἐτήρησάς μου τὸν λόγον καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσω τὸ ὄνομά μου

passages.text: Look at those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead. I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Philadelphia.
Jesus is holy and true.
Jesus holds the key of David.
Some people say they are Jews.
These people are not really Jews.
These people belong to the synagogue of Satan.
These people are liars.
Jesus will act.
Jesus will make these people come to you.
They will bow down at your feet.
They will know that Jesus loves you.
passages.original: ἰδοὺ διδῶ ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς τοῦ Σατανᾶ τῶν λεγόντων ἑαυτοὺς Ἰουδαίους εἶναι καὶ οὐκ εἰσὶν ἀλλὰ ψεύδονται ἰδοὺ ποιήσω αὐτοὺς ἵνα ἥξουσιν καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν ἐνώπιον τῶν ποδῶν σου καὶ γνῶσιν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἠγάπησά σε

passages.text: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Philadelphia.
You have obeyed My command to persevere.
You have shown patience and faithfulness.
I will protect you from the hour of testing.
This time of testing will soon come upon the whole world.
It will test all who live on the earth.
passages.original: Ὅτι ἐτήρησας τὸν λόγον τῆς ὑπομονῆς μου κἀγώ σε τηρήσω ἐκ τῆς ὥρας τοῦ πειρασμοῦ τῆς μελλούσης ἔρχεσθαι ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκουμένης ὅλης πειράσαι τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

passages.text: I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Philadelphia.
Jesus says, "I am coming soon."
Hold tightly to what you have.
Do this so that no one takes your crown.
passages.original: ἔρχομαι ταχύ κράτει ὃ ἔχεις ἵνα μηδεὶς λάβῃ τὸν στέφανόν σου

passages.text: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church.
Jesus promises a reward to the one who overcomes.
I will make the one who overcomes a pillar in the temple of My God.
He will never leave the temple again.
I will write the name of My God on him.
I will write the name of the city of My God on him.
The city is the new Jerusalem.
The new Jerusalem comes down out of heaven from My God.
I will also write My new name on him.
passages.original: Ὁ νικῶν ποιήσω αὐτὸν στῦλον ἐν τῷ ναῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ μου καὶ ἔξω οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃ ἔτι καὶ γράψω ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Θεοῦ μου καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς πόλεως τοῦ Θεοῦ μου τῆς καινῆς Ἰερουσαλήμ ἡ καταβαίνουσα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ μου καὶ τὸ ὄνομά μου τὸ καινόν

passages.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
passages.sermon: The Spirit speaks to the churches.\r\nAnyone who has an ear should listen.\r\nEach person must hear what the Spirit says.
passages.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις

passages.text: To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation.
passages.sermon:
The Amen speaks.
The Amen is the faithful and true Witness.
The Amen is the Originator of God’s creation.
Write these words to the angel of the church in Laodicea.
passages.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ Ἀμήν ὁ μάρτυς ὁ πιστὸς καὶ ἀληθινός ἡ ἀρχὴ τῆς κτίσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were one or the other!
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Laodicea.
Jesus knows their deeds.
They are not cold.
They are not hot.
Jesus wishes they were cold.
Jesus wishes they were hot.
He wants them to be one or the other.
passages.original: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα ὅτι οὔτε ψυχρὸς εἶ οὔτε ζεστός ὄφελον ψυχρὸς ἦς ἢ ζεστός

passages.text: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Laodicea.
Jesus is the Amen.
Jesus is the faithful and true Witness.
Jesus is the Originator of God’s creation.
Jesus says you are lukewarm.
You are not hot.
You are not cold.
Because you are lukewarm, I am about to spit you out of my mouth.
passages.original: οὕτως ὅτι χλιαρὸς εἶ καὶ οὔτε ζεστὸς οὔτε ψυχρός μέλλω σε ἐμέσαι ἐκ τοῦ στόματός μου

passages.text: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
passages.sermon:
You say, "I am rich."
You say, "I have become wealthy."
You say, "I do not need anything."
But you do not know the truth about yourself.
You are wretched.
You are pitiful.
You are poor.
You are blind.
You are naked.
passages.original: Ὅτι λέγεις ὅτι Πλούσιός εἰμι καὶ πεπλούτηκα καὶ οὐδὲν χρείαν ἔχω καὶ οὐκ οἶδας ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ταλαίπωρος καὶ ἐλεεινὸς καὶ πτωχὸς καὶ τυφλὸς καὶ γυμνός

passages.text: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Laodicea.
He gives advice.
He says, “Buy gold from Me.
This gold is refined by fire.
If you buy this gold, you will become truly rich.
Buy white garments from Me.
If you wear these garments, you will be clothed.
Your shameful nakedness will not be seen.
Buy salve from Me to put on your eyes.
If you use this salve, you will be able to see.”
passages.original: συμβουλεύω σοι ἀγοράσαι παρ’ ἐμοῦ χρυσίον πεπυρωμένον ἐκ πυρὸς ἵνα πλουτήσῃς καὶ ἱμάτια λευκὰ ἵνα περιβάλῃ καὶ μὴ φανερωθῇ ἡ αἰσχύνη τῆς γυμνότητός σου καὶ κολλούριον ἐγχρῖσαι τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου ἵνα βλέπῃς

passages.text: Those I love, I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks these words.
Jesus loves certain people.
Jesus rebukes those He loves.
Jesus disciplines those He loves.
Be earnest.
Repent.
passages.original: ἐγὼ ὅσους ἐὰν φιλῶ ἐλέγχω καὶ παιδεύω ζήλευε οὖν καὶ μετανόησον

passages.text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church.
Jesus stands at the door.
Jesus knocks at the door.
Anyone can hear Jesus’ voice.
If someone hears Jesus’ voice, that person can open the door.
If a person opens the door, Jesus will come in to that person.
Jesus will eat with that person.
That person will eat with Jesus.
passages.original: Ἰδοὺ ἕστηκα ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν καὶ κρούω ἐάν τις ἀκούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ ἀνοίξῃ τὴν θύραν καὶ εἰσελεύσομαι πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ δειπνήσω μετ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς μετ’ ἐμοῦ

passages.text: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the churches.
Jesus promises a reward.
Anyone who overcomes will receive this reward.
I will give that person the right to sit with Me on My throne.
I also overcame.
I sat down with My Father on His throne.
In the same way, the one who overcomes will sit with Me.
passages.original: Ὁ νικῶν δώσω αὐτῷ καθίσαι μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐν τῷ θρόνῳ μου ὡς κἀγὼ ἐνίκησα καὶ ἐκάθισα μετὰ τοῦ Πατρός μου ἐν τῷ θρόνῳ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”
passages.sermon: The Spirit speaks to the churches.\r\nAnyone who has an ear should listen.\r\nEach person must hear what the Spirit says.
passages.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις
